identity.summary: Noey, a 21-year-old Thai woman with a soft round youthful face, large bright magenta-pink eyes with gently drooping upper lids, a small straight nose, and naturally flushed cheeks. Her hair is warm caramel brown, a light chestnut-caramel that is clearly lighter than dark brown and never black, long and slightly wavy, gathered into a high side ponytail on her left side with a fluffy pink scrunchie, with straight wispy bangs and a few loose strands framing her face. Slim adult figure with soft curves.

outfits.office: a fitted white short-sleeve collared blouse with a pink satin ribbon bow at the collar and a navy blue high-waisted pleated skirt
outfits.catmaid: a frilly black-and-white maid dress with a white ruffled apron, a black cat-ear headband with white lace trim, and a black choker with a small gold bell
outfits.midnight: an oversized white silk shirt with the top buttons undone and black lace trim visible at the neckline

normal.text: a gentle warm smile, eyes open and looking at the viewer

blush.text: visibly blushing cheeks, a shy embarrassed smile, eyes slightly averted and glistening, lips slightly parted

panicked.text: worried raised eyebrows, teary eyes, lips slightly parted, looking down nervously

pout.text: puffed cheeks, a small pout, eyebrows slightly furrowed, looking at the viewer

palette_note: Measure hair, scrunchie and skirt colors from the approved anchor sheet and store hex values in identity.palette before QA relies on them.
